description:
Upgrade your Ram with the OEDRO FRP Hard Quad-Fold Tonneau Cover—built for durability, security, and style. Custom-fit for 2002-2024 Dodge Ram 1500 Classic & 2003-2026 Ram 2500 3500 8ft beds, this cover features tough fiberglass-reinforced panels that stand up to weather, impact, and daily use. The sleek, low-profile design enhances your truck's look while keeping your cargo safe from rain, snow, and theft. With no drilling required, you’ll be up and running in minutes. Plus, the included LED bed light adds visibility exactly when you need it. Whether you're hauling tools or heading out for adventure, trust OEDRO to protect what you carry.
Features
Secure Fit with Added Convenience: This tonneau cover is engineered for a precise, secure fit and includes thoughtful upgrades. a complimentary LED light for improved nighttime visibility.
Superior Cargo Protection: Built with high-strength fiberglass (FRP) panels, this hard quad-fold tonneau cover offers exceptional protection against rain, snow, and road debris. It also resists impact and sharp objects, keeping your cargo safe and secure in all conditions.
Quick, No-Drill Installation: Designed for hassle-free setup, this FRP hard Quad-fold tonneau cover installs easily with clear instructions and requires no drilling. Get it mounted quickly and ready to use. (Note: Cargo racks must be removed prior to installation.)
Heavy-Duty Durability You Can Trust: Reinforced fiberglass panels deliver long-lasting strength and impressive load-bearing capacity. A robust locking system keeps the cover firmly closed while driving, giving you confidence on every trip.
Safe & Reliable Operation: Install the cover according to the included instructions and ensure all bolts are fully tightened before driving. For safety, do not drive with the tonneau cover partially open.
1-year Warranty. For your safety, professional installation is recommended
